Odd

You have never fit the expected answer, and have learned to make that useful.

Rules

Agreed: no attribute minimums; HP contribution +3. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Arms, Marksmanship, Armor, Guard, Athletics, Subterfuge, Influence, Scholarship, Wilderness, Craft, Medicine, Flame, Frost, Storm, Life, Radiance, Mind, Calling.

Discipline pricing: Adjacent for every discipline.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2fa9c131652bbd94.JournalEntryPage.1bbc193cac7dec07]{Sideways Thinking} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.4ea95456a513f341.JournalEntryPage.80d7820a0f81a501]{Useful Interruption} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.cfa9ba9a67b27db0.JournalEntryPage.b09be2f267ec6857]{Always a Way Around}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.da5285c5bd71917e.JournalEntryPage.8e305be8acc2c2c4]{Unlikely Assistant} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f2e112580fbef655.JournalEntryPage.ee673ae6f05609b2]{Change the Question} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d7e4fe39881d44c3.JournalEntryPage.d7188cf999ea95df]{Wrong Place for That}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.351b4fde9a780f83.JournalEntryPage.4857ac9941d26330]{Strange but Effective} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6456fc67ba53428a.JournalEntryPage.98c27266e8eed6a5]{An Unexpected Exit} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.de345b81282567c2.JournalEntryPage.43315784cd9f0b9a]{One Last Remark}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Reframe a task, distract usefully, or escape after exertion. - Level 3: Assist unusually well, uncover an alternate approach, or pull a companion out of trouble. - Level 7: Apply ingenious force, escape with a partner, or turn pain into a response.

Starting coin contribution: +0 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
